rail_guard.text: Colbert Station, named for Con Colbert, one of the leaders executed after the 1916 Rising. Born in County Limerick.
The Wildlore rail runs to any town on this island you have visited. Where to?

lim_treaty_guide.text: After the Battle of the Boyne, the Jacobite army held Limerick through two sieges. Patrick Sarsfield led the defence. He's a hero here. There's a statue and a bridge and a great many pubs.
The Treaty let the soldiers sail to France with honour, the Wild Geese, they called them. The civil articles for the Catholics who stayed were never honoured. Hence the Broken Treaty.

lim_rugby_fan.text: Thomond Park is famous for its silence. When a Munster man is kicking for goal, twenty-five thousand people go so quiet you could hear a pin drop on the hallowed sod.
The anthem's 'Stand Up and Fight'. Sung loud. Usually just before we do.

lim_hurling_fan.text: Limerick won the All-Ireland hurling in 2018 and then four in a row, 2020 to 2023. I've been hoarse since 2018.
Hurling's the fastest field game on grass. A sliotar can go a hundred and fifty kilometres an hour. My nerves can't.

lim_lace_maker.text: Limerick lace is needlework on net, tambour or needle-run. It took a girl months to make a veil. Queen Victoria had some, of course.
It's slow work. You can't rush lace. You can't rush a lace maker either. Try.

lim_river_warden.text: That's the Shannon. Biggest river on these islands. It drops about a hundred metres from source to sea and most of that drop is right here, at Ardnacrusha and the rapids.
The salmon used to run up past the castle in their thousands. They're fewer now. We're working on it, and so are they.

lim_verse_scholar.text: Did the limerick come from Limerick? Ah. That's the question. There was a parlour game where each guest made up a verse and everybody sang 'Will you come up to Limerick?'. Maybe. Possibly. Nobody can prove a thing.

Here's one for you: 'The limerick's a curious beast, / From the city, or not in the least. / Though the name's a mystery, / We'll take it for history, / And we'll celebrate with a big feast.' I'm working on it.

lim_mccourt_fan.text: 'Worse than the ordinary miserable childhood is the miserable Irish childhood, and worse yet is the miserable Irish Catholic childhood.' That's the start of Angela's Ashes.
The lanes he wrote about are long gone. The rain he wrote about is still here. Bring a coat.

lim_butcher.text: Limerick ham, boiled, then glazed and baked, with cabbage and parsley sauce. The Sunday dinner of your dreams.
Limerick was called Pigtown once, for all the bacon factories. We say it with pride. Mostly.

lim_engineer.text: Ardnacrusha was the biggest engineering job the new state had ever done. German engineers, Irish labourers, five years of digging canals.
When it opened, there was talk it was too big for the country. Within a decade it was supplying most of Ireland's electricity. Somebody owed somebody an apology.
